name: pr_queue_contract_manifest
description: Queue contract manifest listing required regression case IDs and preserved capabilities for PR queue durable prioritization plan

preserved_capabilities.stale_root_plan_exclusion: Branches without a scoped plan file never inherit completed waves from root implementation_plan.md; report completed=? · open=?
preserved_capabilities.truthful_readiness_state: Branches with zero authored commits or unverified wave completion cannot claim Fast-Lane; report Authoring or Ready for Qualification
preserved_capabilities.diagnostic_ledger_action_and_rationale: Compact and diagnostic queue views preserve Next Action, Ranking Rationale, Blocker, and explicit missing Evidence together
preserved_capabilities.governed_runner_test_collection_parity: Explicitly selected pytest and unittest modules collect matching test case IDs, and zero-collection on requested targets fails closed
preserved_capabilities.fail_closed_test_canary: A failing test assertion triggers a non-zero exit code and fails the gate in both unittest and pytest runners
preserved_capabilities.branch_local_plan_progress_recovery: Untracked, modified, and branch-scoped plan documents in active worktrees are discovered, binding actual progress to the branch
preserved_capabilities.open_precedence_and_reopening_visibility: Explicit OPEN indicators override descriptive completion words, and reopened waves remain visible as open
preserved_capabilities.plan_wave_collision_prevention: Plan ownership records are explicitly scoped by plan_id and branch_id so separate plans cannot collide
preserved_capabilities.fresh_inception_work_preservation: Branches in inception with uncommitted or stash-only work require preservation before any rebase advice
preserved_capabilities.complete_worktree_union_and_canonicaliza: Registered worktrees at any path (external, nested, detached) union with physical entries, assigned canonical IDs without basename collisions
preserved_capabilities.topological_dependency_execution_order: High-priority child branches cannot merge before outstanding hard prerequisites; prerequisites precede children in execution order while child retains work priority
preserved_capabilities.no_false_dependency_on_merged_or_zero_ah: Already-merged ancestors, zero-ahead branches, and file-overlap-only relations do not create false executable dependency constraints
preserved_capabilities.explicit_cycle_and_simulation_error_hand: Circular dependencies and simulation errors produce explicit BLOCKED_CYCLE or PROVISIONAL states and resolution tasks instead of silent success
preserved_capabilities.cross_interface_decision_parity: CLI queue table, JSON output, and rank receipts consume identical decision facts, ranks, and explanations via the unified decision API
preserved_capabilities.business_value_separation_from_heuristic: LOC, test filenames, and commit regexes are never presented as measured business value; unverified branches declare explicit UNKNOWN value statements
preserved_capabilities.row_decision_completeness: Every active queue candidate row contains value statement, relative-order reason, blocker, next step, and completion evidence requirement
preserved_capabilities.immutable_snapshot_history_transitions: Identical inputs produce identical decisions with 0 transitions, and all position movements attribute exact causes and changed evidence
preserved_capabilities.fail_closed_owner_overrides: Manual overrides require owner, reason, scope, and non-expired expiry date, failing closed to deterministic rubric classification on violation
preserved_capabilities.command_output_action_and_rationale_rete: Default command output preserves concrete next actions and useful ranking rationales for all active recommendations beyond mere headings
preserved_capabilities.inspectable_decision_view_capacity: Twenty or more active candidate branches remain fully inspectable without dropping value statements, blockers, or next steps
preserved_capabilities.linked_detail_artifact_integrity: Emitted detail links point to actual on-disk artifacts with complete progress, review, sync, worktree coverage, and stable stash commit identities
preserved_capabilities.accurate_coverage_fraction: Footer displays mathematically accurate fractions for covered vs total physical worktree children and stashes, detecting gaps reliably
preserved_capabilities.empirical_readiness_probe_measurements: Readability probe uses real empirical measurements, removing hardcoded VERIFIED results and reporting unverified when renderer is unavailable
preserved_capabilities.observer_single_run_locking: Single-run process lock prevents concurrent execution collisions, auto-reclaiming dead PID locks
preserved_capabilities.observer_immutable_run_identity: Runs are tagged with timestamp and snapshot hash digest, saving isolated run receipts
preserved_capabilities.observer_notification_deduplication: Suppresses notifications for unchanged queue state and deduplicates repeated identical failure signatures
preserved_capabilities.observer_sleeping_host_resilience: Missed intervals over 24 hours are detected cleanly without generating replay storms or crashing
preserved_capabilities.observer_shadow_qualification_suite: Verified against 6 shadow scenarios including baseline, rerun, rank change, fault alert, fault dedup, and lost progress
